text:
alex: heads-up: our SAST/DAST pipelines started failing after the keystore RBAC cleanup. seeing `AccessDenied` on decrypt calls.
maria: confirmed on `sast-nightly/2026-04-05-01` and `dast-nightly/2026-04-05-02`. error snippet: `{"code":"AccessDenied","message":"principal can't decrypt key"}`
sam: which principals are affected? ephemeral runner SAs or long-lived CI SAs?
alex: both. we trimmed a bunch of key-level bindings in PR #1410.
devsec-bot: Alert: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE affecting repos: redwood-web, redwood-core, inference-sdk. Signature: KMS_KEY_BINDING_REMOVED_V2.
priya: quick triage — this blocks evidence packaging and test fixtures that need runtime secrets. not release-blocking but blocks triage for new findings.
carla: I'm owner of the sdlc keys. I can rebind the scanner principals but we should do a controlled rollback.
ops: scheduled short maintenance: rebind scan principals from 4932123472 -> 4932123500 by carla.
maria: can we add a CI preflight check that decrypts a known blob with both the runner SA and ephemeral pod SA so future RBAC prunes fail-fast?
jon: +1. propose job `keystore-preflight` that runs in the same context as the step that needs keystore. snippet: `keystore decrypt --key $SAST_KEY --ciphertext sample.ct` and `keystore decrypt --key $DAST_KEY --ciphertext sample.ct` in both runner and pod.
sam: also recommend adding an RBAC change checklist to PR template: list of affected keys, SAs, test plan, and rollback command.
priya: we should capture these in the RBAC Playbook and require an approver from security for key-level changes.
devsec-bot: Audit Event: role.bind key=projects/redwood/.../sdlc-scan-key boundTo=[serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood-inference,serviceAccount:dast-scanner@redwood-inference] by carla@redwood.com ts=4932123478
alex: after rebind, reran `sast-nightly/2026-04-05-01` -> artifacts created, but one high SAST match flagged in `utils/path_join` (potential path traversal).
maria: that one looks like a pattern match; runtime sanitization exists. mark as `security:needs-evidence` and add the runtime check to ticket.
jon: propose triage labels: `security:needs-evidence`, `security:fp-provisional`, and `security:fp-confirmed`. automation can attach stacktrace + repro steps.
priya: for noisy rules in tests, add suppression comment `# sec-ignore: TEST_ONLY` and require JIRA ticket link for suppressions.
sam: I'll add the `keystore-preflight` job and a small unit test that simulates decrypt fail to ensure CI surfaces the correct error message.
carla: created follow-up ticket SEC-2402 to formalize RBAC checklist, add preflight CI job, and update suppression guidelines.
alex: list of action items: (1) carla rebind (done), (2) sam add preflight job, (3) priya & maria update RBAC Playbook and PR template, (4) jon add triage label automation, (5) create test for decrypt failure.
maria: i'll draft the PR comment template for triage evidence tonight.
devsec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2402 by carla@redwood.com.
alex: thanks all. closing this thread once SEC-2402 has the preflight job merged. :thumbsup:
